parameters.content:
## 1 · Pick (Supabase)
High-value buyers dormant > 365 days. Skips anyone contacted in the last 90 days. 10% random holdout (hash of customer + run) so the lift can be measured. Only customer_id leaves the database.

## 2 · Write + check
One message per favourite-category group: 1 OpenRouter call. Code guardrail: no number, %, discount word, or missing {{first_name}}; otherwise a safe template is used.

## 3 · Human approval
Dashboard gets the summary at once. The CRM manager approves in Telegram (48 h). The decision and the messages are stored on the run; nothing is sent to customers without a yes.

meta.description: Monthly + on-demand reactivation of high-value dormant buyers: Supabase picks the audience with a 10% holdout, OpenRouter writes one guarded Arabic message per category, CRM manager approves in Telegram.
